applicability_conditions: learner must use the fact that a point on an axis has one coordinate equal to zero
use when an intercept or an axis-constrained point is guessed from a picture instead of derived
known_limitations: does not decide whether an intercept exists for a degenerate relation
does not replace distance-formula competence in equidistance problems

applicability_conditions: learner must expand a squared binomial in algebra or coordinate geometry
use when distance/equidistance modelling is correct but expansion fails
known_limitations: does not repair unrelated equality transformations
does not cover higher-degree binomial powers

applicability_conditions: learner must decide whether coordinate points lie on one straight line
use after ordered-pair and slope semantics are stable
known_limitations: slope comparison needs a vertical-line branch
does not teach the full theory of affine dependence

applicability_conditions: learner must transform an equation while preserving the same solution set
use when a later algebra step fails after a valid model or equation has already been formed
known_limitations: does not by itself teach sign arithmetic
does not establish a preferred system-solving method for every structure

applicability_conditions: learner must decide whether a foundational statement is a common notion or a geometric postulate
use when classification is driven by familiar wording rather than by what the statement asserts
known_limitations: does not settle historical variation between editions of the Elements
does not establish independence or consistency of the axiom set

applicability_conditions: learner must preserve the meaning of a compound expression such as x+y or x-y
use when a correct model is followed by collapsing a compound expression into one variable
known_limitations: not a substitute for solving simultaneous equations
does not diagnose arithmetic slips

applicability_conditions: a geometric condition must be translated into coordinate equations
use when geometry setup should be preserved separately from downstream algebra execution
known_limitations: depends on valid coordinate-distance semantics
does not repair binomial expansion by itself

applicability_conditions: learner must produce a line equation from a direction plus an anchoring point
use when a remembered equation form is written before the given data is interpreted
known_limitations: does not handle vertical lines through the ratio route without a separate case
does not establish that supplied points are correct

applicability_conditions: learner must extend a declared constant-rate relation to a value outside the given data
use when a prediction is made by pattern-spotting rather than by applying a stated rate
known_limitations: does not justify that the relation is linear beyond the declared model
does not quantify uncertainty of the prediction

applicability_conditions: learner must interpret (x,y) roles in coordinate tasks
use before slope/collinearity teaching when coordinate-role evidence is unknown or unstable
known_limitations: does not establish slope sign rules by itself
does not prove collinearity criteria

applicability_conditions: learner must relate interior angles on one side of a transversal to whether two lines meet
use when parallelism is asserted from the picture instead of from the angle condition
known_limitations: applies to the Euclidean plane and not to non-Euclidean geometries
does not supply the angle measures themselves

applicability_conditions: learner must decide what a parameter must satisfy for a stated conclusion to hold
use when a parameter is solved for numerically although only a condition is required
known_limitations: does not cover parameters entering non-linearly without a separate treatment
does not establish that the stated property is well posed

applicability_conditions: learner must predict the quadrant of a point after a sign change of one or both coordinates
use when quadrant answers are recalled by number rather than derived from coordinate signs
known_limitations: does not address points lying on an axis, which belong to no quadrant
does not cover rotations or non-sign transformations

applicability_conditions: learner must combine or divide rational quantities while keeping the quantity each number names
use when a quotient is computed but its meaning as a per-unit or share size is not recoverable
known_limitations: does not cover irrational or surd arithmetic
does not by itself establish that a modelled ratio is constant

applicability_conditions: learner must combine an object speed and a medium speed into an effective rate
use when downstream and upstream cases are treated as unrelated problems
known_limitations: assumes constant speeds and a uniform current
does not cover vector composition at an angle to the current

applicability_conditions: learner has or can form two linear equations in two unknowns
use when elimination/substitution execution is unstable
known_limitations: does not decide when substitution is more efficient
does not cover nonlinear systems

applicability_conditions: learner must move between coordinate differences, ratio, and contextual rate
use when numerator/denominator roles or units are confused
known_limitations: does not establish linearity of arbitrary data
does not replace coordinate-role prerequisite repair

applicability_conditions: a candidate answer can be checked against original equations, conditions, units, or geometry
use when verification is not self-initiated even though prompted checking may be possible
known_limitations: verification cannot replace correct modelling
some proofs require structural justification rather than numerical substitution

applicability_conditions: learner must count selections in which the order of the chosen items does not matter
use when each pair is counted twice because ordered and unordered selection are conflated
known_limitations: covers selections of size two and does not generalise to larger selections without extension
assumes items are distinguishable and selection is without repetition

applicability_conditions: word context must be converted into one or more variable relations
use when the learner may already model correctly and should not be forced through unnecessary reteaching
known_limitations: does not establish arithmetic fluency
keyword-only heuristics are explicitly rejected
